headline: S&P Global Warns Hormuz Energy Shock Risks Triggering Global Food Crisis
summary: S&P Global warned that ongoing conflicts affecting critical trade routes through the Strait of Hormuz could turn the energy crisis into a global food security crisis.
why: S&P Global is a leading provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, and analytics for global financial and commodity markets.

impacts.name: Agriculture
impacts.why: Disruptions in energy shipping routes elevate fertilizer and transport costs, rippling through global agricultural supply chains.

why_moved: Geopolitical blockages in key maritime choke points threaten vital fertilizer and agricultural inputs, causing broad macroeconomic anxiety.
